metadata.provenance: New synthetic prompts, facts, names and dates authored for this pilot; no model outputs used in selection.
metadata.scoring: Complete semantic rubric review required; regexes are auxiliary lexical signals only.
metadata.execution_gold_boundary: Only execution_cases.prompt enters the user-message path; rubrics, stratum, scenario_id and expected_state are excluded from model input.
metadata.threshold_note: No user-approved quality or responsiveness cutoff; report continuous measures and actual tradeoffs.

memory_seed.clock_basis: UTC; all stored and queried event times use one timezone with no timezone conversion.
memory_seed.confirmation: All remember and correct events are explicitly confirmed synthetic setup operations.

What time window do I prefer for community lantern project meetings?

A room is free from 10:00 to 11:00. Task B takes 20 minutes and must finish before task A, which takes 30 minutes. Start at 10:00 with no overlap or gaps. Give both task intervals and the unused room time.

Which comes first, my materials collection or my dress rehearsal? Give their dates and times, and the interval between them.
A tray has 18 tokens. Add 27 tokens. How many tokens are there now?

Use this ideal arithmetic model: a battery stores 10 Wh and can supply at most 10 W at once. A required lamp draws 4 W; an optional display draws 8 W. Runtime in hours equals Wh divided by total W. Which devices can run while respecting the power limit, and for how long?
Which train station is my favourite?
For my pottery demonstration on 26 September 2026, name the room where I should direct visitors. If the stored information does not support one definite room, explain what needs confirming.
Use 100 centimetres per metre. How many centimetres are in 1.6 metres?

Choose one supplier. Alpha costs 12 credits and delivers Tuesday; Beta costs 10 and delivers Thursday; Gamma costs 15 and delivers Monday. Delivery must be no later than Tuesday, and the budget is 13 credits. Which supplier meets both requirements, and why?
Find the earliest complete community lantern project meeting slot that fits my preferred time window, Idris's availability, and our usual meeting length. Give its start and end times.
What is the name of my community lantern project?
Suppose my dress rehearsal lasts 45 minutes from its stored start time. Would that finish before the stored finish-by time for my next lantern workshop? Give the finish time and remaining margin.
Put these three numbers in ascending order: 12, 3, 8.
Which room is booked for my pottery demonstration on 26 September 2026?

Start an agenda at 10:20. In order, introduction takes 5 minutes, inspection 10, discussion 15, and closing 5. There are no gaps or overlaps. Give the start time for each activity and the final finish time.
